dishes.name: Capuns
dishes.desc: Swiss chard leaves wrapped around a spätzle-like dough with dried meat, baked in cream and milk. The best-known dish of Graubünden, found in Chur's traditional restaurants.

dishes.name: Pizokel
dishes.desc: Thick buckwheat or wheat dumplings, often cooked with cheese, cabbage or butter and sage. A Graubünden mountain staple that Chur restaurants put on the menu.

dishes.name: Maluns
dishes.desc: Grated potatoes roasted slowly in butter with flour until crumbly, usually served with apple sauce. A Graubünden peasant dish found in the Chur area.

dishes.name: Bündner Nusstorte
dishes.desc: Shortcrust tart filled with walnuts in caramel. Graubünden's best-known sweet, sold in every Chur bakery.

dishes.name: Bündnerfleisch
dishes.desc: Air-dried beef, pressed and cured in the dry mountain air, sliced very thin. Graubünden's best-known cured meat, served as a platter in Chur.
